exposure: Standardized, quantitative measurement of blood loss (QBL)
cohort: Mothers (n=372) from 875 consecutive maternities who had both pre- and post-partum hemoglobin recorded in a tertiary obstetric unit in Cardiff, Wales.
finding: Standardized quantitative measurement of blood loss (QBL) showed a moderate correlation (0.57) with adjusted change in hemoglobin, corresponding to an estimated fall of 15.3 g/L per 1000 mL blood loss.
